integrity: The all-parameter result is proved by an exact simplicial decomposition and homotopy-pushout argument. Finite computations are reported only as reproducibility checks and are not used to extrapolate the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes a finite nonempty simple graph \(H\) with no isolated vertices. It asserts ordinary homotopy equivalence, not equivariant or simple-homotopy equivalence. The finite checker is corroborative only and the originality search cannot exclude unindexed folklore.
